name: ephemeris
description: Task manager with separate due and planned dates, for Mac, iPhone and Supernote.

scripts.test: npm -w @ephemeris/core run test && npm -w @ephemeris/worker run test
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm -w @ephemeris/worker run dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm -w @ephemeris/worker run deploy
scripts.plugin: cd supernote && npm install && npm run build
